title: Price Dispersion and Legacy Discounts in the National Television Advertising Market
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Tables 7-10 (mainresults_replication.do) regress log upfront price (and audience/demographic indices) at the telecast-advertiser level on continuous advertiser tenure in the upfront market (age) and quantity, with program x month x conglomerate, network x day-of-week x month and network x season x month FE, plus agency, category, inventory-type, genre-exposure and firm-entry regressors in later columns. No binary treatment adoption.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe, cluster prog_no x mon; Matlab for Figure 2. Nielsen-type proprietary telecast/advertiser data.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous regressors (advertiser age, quantity); many time-varying controls; price-dispersion regressions, not DiD

data_files_note: readme: actual data cannot be shared due to data agreements; simulated datasets do not recreate the paper's results.
